title: If + Present, Will
summary: If + present simple, will + base: If it rains, I will stay home.
rule: If + present simple, will + base: If it rains, I will stay home.
examples: If you need help, call me.
Unless it rains, we will go.

commonMistakes.incorrect: If you need help, call me.
commonMistakes.correct: If you need help, call me.
